research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Kernal Biologics is engaged in developing oncoselective therapies, as described in 'Oncoselective therapy,' which details compositions and methods for disease treatment, and 'Oncoselective cancer therapy,' which outlines nucleic acid lipid particle compositions for cancer treatment using oncoselective construct designs to encode therapeutic payloads. These efforts focus on delivering agents that enable targeted treatment, highlighting research in oncoselective mRNA-based therapies and delivery technologies.

overview_description.description: Kernal creates mRNA therapies to cure diseases like COVID and cancer. Our mRNA therapies instruct specific cells on how to make their own drugs. Kernal won three awards from Amgen and NASA. With roots at MIT, Harvard and Big Pharma, the team previously built a successful Biotech company and has deep expertise in mRNA space.
